body:
The Rust crate at `solace-cli/src` has grown large: `main.rs` 5302 lines, `board.rs` 4532, `lockdown.rs` 3196, `tasks.rs` 2810, `extract.rs` 2474, with tests in a few big files (`board_tests.rs` 1937, Python acceptance files). This feature works out how to refactor and clean the crate, then does it, so the code stays maintainable as Solace grows.

### Goals

- A written refactor plan before any change.
- Oversized modules split into focused ones; duplication collapsed; dead code removed.
- Public CLI behavior unchanged; tests stay green at every step.
- Agents get better direction so future work stays maintainable.
title: Root project refactor and cleanup
